title: Mushroom & Swiss Quiche
description: An easy savory quiche with sliced mushrooms and Swiss cheese in a store-bought pie crust.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and fit the pie crust into a 9-inch pie pan.
Melt butter in a skillet and cook the mushrooms until softened and their extra moisture has cooked away.
Spread the mushrooms and Swiss cheese evenly in the crust.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper together, then pour over the filling.
Bake until the center is set, about 35 to 40 minutes.

storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 4 days. Reheat individual slices until hot.

title: Spinach, Onion & Cheese Quiche
description: An easy spinach-and-onion quiche with cheddar cheese in a store-bought pie crust.

ingredients.item: frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and fit the pie crust into a 9-inch pie pan.
Melt butter in a skillet and cook the onion until softened. Make sure the thawed spinach is squeezed very dry.
Spread the spinach, onion, and cheddar cheese evenly in the crust.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper together, then pour over the filling.
Bake until the center is set, about 35 to 40 minutes.

storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 4 days. Reheat individual slices until hot.
